text.text_excerpt: I'm going to say that for me Phil's is the best burger in New Orleans. The prices aren't necessarily cheap but they're more reasonable than most of the new burger places in town and for a sit-down restaurant with nice decor, friendly atmosphere,and outstanding burgers $9.75 for a meal (plus drink cost) isn't bad. When perusing the menu there's a page of appetizers but the main focus here is clearly "make your own" burgers. Once you're seated you'll take a look at the menu and smartly all the menus have a large pad of order sheets inside so you can fill out your sheet and tear it out for the server. The options are huge and they claim over a million possible combinations - on my first visi...

I was feeling quite carnivorous the other day, and called up the boyfriend to let him know we should hit up the Phil's Grill within walking distance of his house. He got there probably 10 minutes before me, so I asked him to order me the Toussaint Tchoup: fresh apple juice, Maker's Mark, and a delicious slice of bacon. When I arrived, my delicious drink was waiting for me as well as half an order of the potato skin appetizer. Don't tell him, but I may just arrive 10 minutes late all the time because I had food and tasty beverage already waiting for me!!! Phil's Grill is great. I first learned of Phil's Grill through Yelp. The Metarie location was very popular, but I was rarely out that way during lunch. When I read Charles and Sarah's reviews of this location, I knew I had to check it out as soon as humanly possible. Location This is a fantastic building in one of my favorite areas of the city. The renovation was beautifully done and maintains the historic charm, but with a very modern feel. It's a large restaurant so despite the large lunch crowd when I went, it was no problem being immediately seated.
